theorems.name: Submission.cmr_tdn_directional_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (q : X → Euclid n) (h : X → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasure ν → Measurable q → Integrable h ν → (∀ g : Euclid n → Euclid n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ x, h x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid n) (fderiv ℝ g (q x)).toLinearMap ∂ν| ≤ Λ) → ∀ a : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → (∀ y, |a y| ≤ 1) → ∀ z : Euclid n, |∫ x, h x * (a (q x + z) - a (q x)) ∂ν| ≤ Λ * ‖z‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
